Please reload this page . crDroid Android After-market highly customized Android platform for select devices Verified We've verified that the organization crdroidandroid controls the domain: crdroid.net Learn more about verified organizations 1.9k followers https://crdroid.net contact@crdroid.net Overview Repositories Projects Packages People More Overview Repositories Projects Packages People README.md crDroid Android Stability - Performance - Control 🔗 Quick Links ⬇️ Download ✨ Features ❤️ Support us 📝 Blog 💬 Community 🐞 Issues 🛠️ Build yourself 📱 About crDroid crDroid is a custom Android ROM built for stability, performance, and user control. You get a clean Android base with smart features that improve daily use. The goal is simple: ⚡ Fast system. 🧱 Reliable behavior. 🎛️ Full user choice. crDroid emphasizes consistency across devices. Nearly every part of the system is customizable: Status bar Quick settings Navigation & gestures Lockscreen System theming Your device, your rules! 🚀 Performance first Performance matters. crDroid keeps things smooth without dumb or aggressive tweaks. Battery life stays balanced. Animations stay fluid. No gimmicks. 🔐 Security you can trust Security stays up to date. crDroid closely tracks AOSP and ships recent Android security patches. 🌍 Open Source & Community driven crDroid is fully open source. Development happens in the open. Maintainers, developers, and users collaborate transparently. If you want control without sacrificing stability, crDroid is built for you. ⚠️ Warning — Read This Attention users: Flashing custom ROMs always carries risk, especially when the project is fully/partially closed source or lacks public accountability . Such ROMs — including DerpFest — do not provide full source availability or independent review, making it difficult for users to verify what is actually running on their devices. They are usually published by notorious authors banned on major Android communities. You cannot verify what code is running on your device. That means higher risk of privacy issues, data leakage and unauthorized access to personal information Bottom line: ✅ Choose ROMs with publicly available source code ✅ Review commits and development activity ✅ Consider maintainer reputation and community trust Attention developers: Do not accept contributions from banned or unverified individuals. Avoid commits with unclear or incorrect authorship. Use changes only from established, fully open source, trusted sources with transparent commit history. Android 16 ( bka ) and Android 15 ( vic ) remain actively maintained on a stability-focused cadence for the bulk of supported devices. ✨ What Makes Evolution X Great Evolution X blends the best of Pixel with feature-rich customization, built on a clean LineageOS foundation. 🌟 Pixel Exclusive Wallpapers, clock styles, boot animations, sound effects, unlimited Google Photos backup & more — straight from Pixel, on your device 🛠️ Deep Customization Freeform windows, Sidebar, App Lock, per-app volume, icon packs, font switching, and hundreds of UI tweaks — all configured through Evolver , our in-house settings app 🔁 Always Up To Date Monthly Android security patches, fast rebases, and consistent stable releases — no dead ROMs here 🌍 Translated by the Community Localized into dozens of languages by volunteers worldwide via Crowdin — making the ROM accessible to everyone 🧠 Active Community Thousands of users and maintainers across Discord and Telegram — help is always close 📱 Wide Device Support Android 15 through 17 branches — 100+ actively maintained devices, backed by a global team 🔓 Fully Open Source Every line of code is public. Audit it, fork it, learn from it — your device, your rules 📱 Supported Android Versions Branch Status Security Patch Devices Supported Manifest 🔵 Android 17 August 2026 3 (early bring-up) cnb 🟣 Android 16 QPR2 August 2026 45 bka 🟢 Android 15 August 2026 3 vic ⚪ Android 14 August 2026 0 (no longer actively maintained) udc Device counts reflect entries flagged currently_maintained: true in the OTA builds directory for each branch — dropped/unmaintained devices are excluded. Confirm current counts there before publishing, as they shift as devices land or drop. 📊 At a Glance 🔗 Important Links Resource Link 📦 Manifest https://github.com/Evolution-X/manifest 📦 Android 17 Manifest (cnb) https://github.com/Evolution-X/manifest/tree/cnb ⚙️ Evolver (Settings App) https://github.com/Evolution-X/packages_apps_Evolver 📁 Devices Org https://github.com/Evolution-X-Devices 📱 Supported Devices https://evolution-x.org/devices ✨ Features https://evolution-x.org/features 📥 Downloads https://cdn.evolution-x.org 📖 Wiki https://wiki.evolution-x.org 📰 Blog https://evolution-x.org/blog 🐦 Twitter / X https://x.com/EvolutionXROM 🌍 Translations https://crowdin.com/project/Evolution_X 🚀 Getting Started 📲 How to flash Evolution X on your device Check if your device is supported at evolution-x.org/devices Download the latest build from cdn.evolution-x.org — Android 17 (cnb) builds are the primary focus, so check there first for the newest features Boot into a custom recovery (e.g. TWRP or OrangeFox) Flash the ROM zip, optionally flash GApps if not included Wipe cache/dalvik and reboot For detailed instructions, visit the Wiki . ⚠️ Always back up your data before flashing. Flashing a custom ROM will void your warranty. 🔧 Becoming a device maintainer Interested in maintaining Evolution X for your device? We're especially looking for help bringing devices up on the Android 17 (cnb) branch. Reach out on Discord and contact Onelots or Manidweep . ⚙️ Contributing to Evolver, our settings app Most of the user-facing customization in Evolution X lives in Evolver , our settings app. If you're comfortable with Java/Kotlin and Android UI work, this is one of the most approachable places to start contributing — from small preference-screen cleanups to new Compose-based features. Fork packages_apps_Evolver and check the cnb branch for the latest work Browse open issues or ask in Discord for good first tasks Submit a pull request — Gerrit-style commit messages are appreciated 🌍 Contributing translations Evolution X is localized by volunteers on Crowdin . If you speak a language other than English, you can help make the ROM accessible to more people around the world. How to get started: Visit the project at crowdin.com/project/Evolution_X Create a free Crowdin account or sign in Select your language from the list Start translating strings — no technical knowledge required! Translations are reviewed and merged into the ROM regularly 💡 Every contribution counts — even a few translated strings help users in your region have a better experience. 👥 Contributors Evolution X is built by contributors across the entire org — manifest, frameworks, device trees, and Evolver , our settings app where most user-facing features take shape. Core manifest & frameworks Evolver (Settings App) 🔐 Security & Transparency Evolution X is fully open source . Every line of code is publicly available for review — from system components to build scripts. We believe users have the right to inspect what's running on their devices. When choosing a custom ROM, we recommend: ✅ Verifying that source code is publicly available ✅ Reviewing recent commit history and development activity ✅ Checking maintainer reputation and community trust 💖 Support the Project If you find Evolution X useful, consider supporting the developers: ⭐ Thanks for checking out Evolution X! Then use the menu to select Recovery Mode . Bootloader/Fastboot/Download : With the device powered off, hold Volume Down + Power . candidates.text: Info about aurora | LineageOS Wiki LineageOS Wiki Toggle navigation Devices Contribute FAQ Glossary lineageos.org open_in_new search Use light theme light_mode keyboard_arrow_left Devices Sony Xperia XZ2 Premium codename: aurora Downloads Get the builds here Guides Installation Build for yourself Update to a newer build of the same LineageOS version Upgrade to a higher version of LineageOS (e.g. lineage-20 -> lineage-22.2) Special boot modes Recovery : With the device powered off, hold Volume Down + Power . Bootloader/Fastboot/Download : With the device powered off, hold Volume Up and connect the USB cable. The notification light should turn blue. Known quirks Device integrity Find help online You can find assistance with LineageOS on our subreddit , on our Discord server , or in #LineageOS on Libera.Chat . Report a bug If you’d like to report a bug, follow the instructions here . Sony Xperia XZ2 Premium (aurora) Released April 2018 Specifications SoC Qualcomm SDM845 Snapdragon 845 RAM 6 GB CPU Octa-core Kryo 385 4 x 2.7 GHz + 4 x 1.7 GHz Architecture arm64 GPU Qualcomm Adreno 630 Network 2G GSM 3G UMTS 4G LTE Storage 64 GB UFS2.1 SD card Up to 400 GB hybrid SIM slot Screen 5.8 in (147.32 mm) 3840x2160 (759 PPI) IPS LCD Bluetooth 5.0 with A2DP + aptX HD Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac Peripherals Accelerometer Compass Dual SIM Fingerprint reader GPS Gyroscope Light sensor NFC Proximity sensor Cameras 3 19 MP, LED flash 12 MP, LED flash 13 MP, No flash Dimensions 158 mm (6.22 in) (h) 80 mm (3.15 in) (w) 11.9 mm (0.47 in) (d) Battery Non-removable Li-Ion 3540 mAh LineageOS info Maintainer dtrunk90 Current version 22.2 (Android 15) Kernel version 4.9 ( source code ) Supported models H8116 H8166 help_outline Don't see yours? candidates.title: Info about mars | LineageOS Wiki
candidates.text: Info about mars | LineageOS Wiki LineageOS Wiki Toggle navigation Devices Contribute FAQ Glossary lineageos.org open_in_new search Use light theme light_mode keyboard_arrow_left Devices Xiaomi Mi 11 Pro codename: mars Downloads Get the builds here Guides Installation Build for yourself Update to a newer build of the same LineageOS version Upgrade to a higher version of LineageOS (e.g. lineage-22.1 -> lineage-23.2) Special boot modes Recovery : With the device powered off, hold Volume Up + Power . Keep holding both buttons until the “MI” logo appears on the screen, then release. Bootloader/Fastboot/Download : With the device powered off, hold Volume Down + Power . Keep holding both buttons until the word “FASTBOOT” appears on the screen, then release. Known quirks Device integrity Find help online You can find assistance with LineageOS on our subreddit , on our Discord server , or in #LineageOS on Libera.Chat . Report a bug If you’d like to report a bug, follow the instructions here . Xiaomi Mi 11 Pro (mars) Released March 2021 Specifications SoC Qualcomm SM8350 Snapdragon 888 RAM 8/12GB LPDDR5 CPU Octa-core Kryo 680 1 x 2.84 GHz + 3 x 2.42 GHz + 4 x 1.8 GHz Architecture arm64 GPU Qualcomm Adreno 660 Network 2G GSM 2G CDMA 3G UMTS 3G CDMA2000 4G LTE 5G NR Storage 128/256 GB Screen 6.81 in (172.97 mm) 1440x3200 (515 PPI) Super AMOLED (max. 120 Hz) Bluetooth 5.2 with A2DP + aptX HD Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax Peripherals A-GPS Accelerometer Barometer Compass Dual SIM Dual-frequency GNSS Fingerprint reader BeiDou Galileo GLONASS GPS NavIC SBAS QZSS Gyroscope IR blaster Light sensor NFC Qi wireless charging Qi reverse wireless charging Stereo speakers Ultrasound proximity sensor USB OTG Cameras 4 50 MP (main), LED flash 8 MP (periscope telephoto), LED flash 13 MP (ultrawide), LED flash 20 MP (front), No flash Dimensions 164.3 mm (6.47 in) (h) 74.6 mm (2.94 in) (w) 8.5 mm (0.33 in) (d) Battery Non-removable Li-Po 5000 mAh LineageOS info Maintainer WilliamSado Current version 23.2 (Android 16) Kernel version 5.4 ( source code ) Supported models M2102K1AC help_outline Don't see yours? Keep holding both buttons until the “MI” logo appears on the screen, then release. Bootloader/Fastboot/Download : With the device powered off, hold Volume Down + Power . Keep holding both buttons until the word “FASTBOOT” appears on the screen, then release. Known quirks Device integrity Find help online You can find assistance with LineageOS on our subreddit , on our Discord server , or in #LineageOS on Libera.Chat . Report a bug If you’d like to report a bug, follow the instructions here . Keep holding both buttons until the “Mi 8” logo appears on the screen, then release. Bootloader/Fastboot/Download : With the device powered off, hold Volume Down + Power . Keep holding both buttons until the word “FASTBOOT” appears on the screen, then release. candidates.text: Info about gemini | LineageOS Wiki LineageOS Wiki Toggle navigation Devices Contribute FAQ Glossary lineageos.org open_in_new search Use light theme light_mode keyboard_arrow_left Devices Xiaomi Mi 5 codename: gemini Downloads Get the builds here Guides Installation Build for yourself Update to a newer build of the same LineageOS version Upgrade to a higher version of LineageOS (e.g. lineage-20 -> lineage-22.2) Special boot modes Recovery : With the device powered off, hold Volume Up + Power . Keep holding both buttons until the “MI” logo appears on the screen, then release. Bootloader/Fastboot/Download : With the device powered off, hold Volume Down + Power . Keep holding both buttons until the word “FASTBOOT” appears on the screen, then release. Known quirks Device integrity Find help online You can find assistance with LineageOS on our subreddit , on our Discord server , or in #LineageOS on Libera.Chat . Report a bug If you’d like to report a bug, follow the instructions here .
